{{Top|leg}}
The '''tree-rangers''' were an organization on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yelsain/Legends|Yelsain]]. They were brash and outgoing, and were a favorite topic for [[Holodrama/Legends|holodrama]] makers from [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]]. However, the people of Yelsain hated the popularity of the tree-rangers and visitors to the planet asking where to find the tree-rangers was a dangerous proposition.
